{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.40

|gr1= Waypoints

|gr2= Remote Control

|descr= Enables/disables the option for player to set waypoints for UAV in AV terminal.

|s1= uav [[enableUAVWaypoints]] enable

|p1= uav: [[Object]]

|p2= enable: [[Boolean]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
_uav enableUAVWaypoints false;
hint str waypointsEnabledUAV _uav; // returns false
</sqf>
